name: Ákos Hadházy, Bernadett Szél, Szabolcs Szabó
detail: May 2020 bill for a special levy on those who received at least HUF 5bn revenue from state or EU funds 2012-2020: a retroactive levy on public-money receipts, not a tax on net wealth; rejected by the economic committee.

name: MGYOSZ, MKIK, VOSZ and 11 other business federations
detail: Oct 2026 joint position asks for a third rate band for wealth of HUF 1-5bn and carve-outs for business assets: comments on the draft, not support for the tax.

name: Klára Dobrev
detail: Did not vote on either EP wealth-tax amendment (howtheyvote.eu votes 155121, 162327).

name: Fidesz and KDNP
detail: Both parties rejected the draft on 6 Oct 2026 ("A Fidesz semmilyen adóemelést nem támogat").

name: György Wáberer
detail: April 2026 remark quoted by Telex that the rich pay tax elsewhere and the ordinary person pays proportionally more; names no wealth tax.

name: Viktor Zsiday
detail: Investment adviser who criticised the Tisza wealth tax.
